API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIFirewall PoliciesFirewall Filtering Rules Resource Get Firewall Filtering Rules
Firewall Filtering Rules Resource Get Firewall Filtering Rules
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/firewallFilteringRules

Retrieves all rules in the Firewall Filtering policy

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
ruleName
string

Filters rules based on rule names using the specified keywords

ruleLabel
string

Filters rules based on rule labels using the specified keywords

ruleOrder
string

Filters rules based on rule order using the specified keywords

ruleDescription
string

Filters rules based on rule description using the specified keywords

ruleAction
string

Filters rules based on rule actions using the specified keywords

location
string

Filters rules based on locations using the specified keywords

department
string

Filters rules based on user departments using the specified keywords

group
string

Filters rules based on user groups using the specified keywords

user
string

Filters rules based on users using the specified keywords

device
string

Filters rules based on devices using the specified keywords

deviceGroup
string

Filters rules based on device groups using the specified keywords

deviceTrustLevel
string

Filters rules based on device trust levels using the specified keywords

srcIps
string

Filters rules based on source IP addresses using the specified keywords

destAddresses
string

Filters rules based on destination IP addresses using the specified keywords

srcIpGroups
string

Filters rules based on source IP groups using the specified keywords

destIpGroups
string

Filters rules based on destination IP groups using the specified keywords

nwApplication
string

Filters rules based on network applications using the specified keywords

nwServices
string

Filters rules based on network services using the specified keywords

destIpCategories
string

Filters rules based on destination URL categories using the specified keywords

page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is set to 5,000, if not specified.

Default value: 5000
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier for the Firewall Filtering policy rule

name
string
REQUIRED

Name of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

order
int32

Rule order number of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

rank
int32

Admin rank of the Firewall Filtering policy rule

locations
object[]
locationGroups
object[]
departments
object[]
groups
object[]
users
object[]
timeWindows
object[]
workloadGroups
object[]
action
string

The action the Firewall Filtering policy rule takes when packets match the rule

Possible values: [ALLOW, BLOCK_DROP, BLOCK_RESET, BLOCK_ICMP, EVAL_NWAPP]

state
string

Determines whether the Firewall Filtering policy rule is enabled or disabled

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

description
string

Additional information about the rule

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the rule was last modified. Ignored if the request is POST or PUT. For GET, ignored if or the rule is current version.

lastModifiedBy
object
srcIps
string[]

User-defined source IP addresses for which the rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific source IP address.

srcIpGroups
object[]
srcIpv6Groups
object[]

excludeSrcCountries
boolean

Indicates whether the countries specified in the sourceCountries field are included or excluded from the rule. A true value denotes that the specified source countries are excluded from the rule. A false value denotes that the rule is applied to the source countries if there is a match.

destAddresses
string[]

List of destination IP addresses for which the rule is applicable. CIDR notation can be used for destination IP addresses. If not set, the rule is not restricted to a specific destination addresses unless specified by destCountries, destIpGroups or destIpCategories.

destIpCategories
string[]

IP address categories of destination for which the DNAT rule is applicable. If not set, the rule is not restricted to specific destination IP categories.

nwApplicationGroups
object[]
appServices
object[]
appServiceGroups
object[]
devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

labels
object[]
defaultRule
boolean

If set to true, the default rule is applied

Default value: false
predefined
boolean

If set to true, a predefined rule is applied

Default value: false
]
